name: asic-baseline
argv: source /OpenROAD-flow-scripts/env.sh && python3 labs/21-physical-closure/run.py asic --candidate baseline --output-dir labs/build/audit-asic-baseline

name: asic-equivalence
argv: source /OpenROAD-flow-scripts/env.sh && python3 labs/21-physical-closure/verify_netlist.py labs/build/audit-asic-repair && python3 labs/25-hardware-ci/physical_gate.py labs/build/audit-asic-repair

name: asic-repair
argv: source /OpenROAD-flow-scripts/env.sh && python3 labs/21-physical-closure/run.py asic --candidate repair --output-dir labs/build/audit-asic-repair

name: asic-slow
argv: source /OpenROAD-flow-scripts/env.sh && python3 labs/21-physical-closure/run.py asic --candidate slow --output-dir labs/build/audit-asic-slow

name: closure-collection
argv: source /OpenROAD-flow-scripts/env.sh && python3 labs/21-physical-closure/collect.py --prefix audit --reference-dir labs/build/audit-closure-reference && python3 labs/21-physical-closure/verify_reference.py --reference-dir labs/build/audit-closure-reference && python3 /audit/compare.py

name: confirm-missing-tools
argv: import json,shutil; from pathlib import Path; p=Path('/faults/formal/report.json'); r=json.loads(p.read_text()); assert r['status']=='fail' and 'yosys' in r['error'] and not r['jobs']; shutil.copyfile(p,'/results/audit-missing-tools.json'); print('PASS missing tool records fail status and specific error')

name: layout-collection
argv: source /OpenROAD-flow-scripts/env.sh && python3 labs/22-layout-verification/collect.py labs/build/audit-layout --input-report labs/build/audit-asic-repair/report.json --reference-dir labs/build/audit-layout-reference && python3 labs/22-layout-verification/verify_reference.py --reference-dir labs/build/audit-layout-reference && python3 /audit-tools/verify.py report layout labs/build/audit-layout/report.json

name: layout
argv: source /OpenROAD-flow-scripts/env.sh && python3 labs/22-layout-verification/run.py --input-dir labs/build/audit-asic-repair --output-dir labs/build/audit-layout && klayout -zz -rd out=/work/labs/build/audit-layout -rm labs/22-layout-verification/audit_ports.py
